clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post, a Warsong scout records what the Horde needs to know about Ashenvale.

Warsong scouts watch the woods as the Horde seeks timber and supply routes through Ashenvale. From Splintertree Post, a fortified encampment, they track night elf sentinels and movements across the territory. Their observations reach Kadrak at the Barrens-Ashenvale border among routine orders. He uses them to judge troop readiness and coordinate supplies and travel through the contested woods.
